Coram : INDIRA BANERJEE*, J.K. MAHESHWARI
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: s.482 – Quashing of proceedings – Dishonour of cheque – Account Payee Cheque signed by accused no. 2, who was M.D. of the Company in favour of respondent in discharge of liability – On dishonour u/s.138 r/w s.141 of NI Act – In the complaint, appellants who were independent/non-executive director were impleaded as accused no. 3 to 5 – Appellants unsuccessfully filed application in High Court u/s.482 praying that the proceeding be quashed – Hence instant appeal
Decision Date : 01-08-2022 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1105/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
